audit: All new included original source files streamhash versus frozen sourceSHA; stored RAW or concatenated gzip roundtrip versus same SHA/size, every stored part SHA/size/CRC, every physical Git-stage file strictly<100MiB.

Old manifest metadata only; reject all delta logical/raw/part/descriptor collisions before opening new bodies. Rehash unchanged base manifest after audit; no old raw dataset/model/evaluation file bodies.
Exact SOURCE_ARCHIVE records occur in DELTA; separate physical descriptor records and BUILD physical_files close stored paths, delta/chain/readme.
Scan new logical text plus additional new physical text for credential formats; output only redacted type/path/line, never token content. This format scan is not a general secret detector.

Only three named portable entry pages receive relative-link checks. Copied provenance Markdown is scanned for credentials but not treated as a portable entry. Verify new index ends with old index bytes in same parent, global readme ends with preserved prior bytes.
link_target_policy: V2 only: explicit ordinary regular files OR ordinary directories exist; every component opened with NOFOLLOW, no directory enumeration/content read. Symlinks refused, no logical gzip fallback. All other byte/credential/collision checks unchanged.
body_interpretation: No image/model/NPZ/evaluation decode or semantic data parse; manifests/chain/descriptors are administrative metadata, other text is regex/link audit only. No network or Git commands.
